      "reason": "This is a general contract term regarding agreement duration rather than data consent."

    },
    {
      "clause_id": "k7",
      "rule_id": "R02",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence": "Collected personal data shall be utilized exclusively for the specific operational objectives for which it was originally gathered",
      "reason": "The clause adheres to purpose limitation by restricting data use to original operational objectives."
    }
  ]
